intro: Everything you can do in THE MARKET, step by step. Pick a chapter. Keys look like [THIS]; you can change most of them in SETTINGS, KEYS. Press [SHIFT] + [G] to open or close this guide anywhere.

chapters.title: GETTING STARTED
chapters.what: Walk, run, jump and use things. Almost everything is used by double-clicking it.
steps: Walk with [W] [A] [S] [D] or the arrow keys.
Hold [SHIFT] to run. Press [SPACE] to jump. Hold [C] to crouch.
Double-click a thing to walk to it and use it: a door, a seat, a lamp, a person, even yourself.
Double-click does nothing while something is in your hands. Press [1] until your hands are free.
Press [?] for the list of every key. Press [ESC] for the menu.
Your game saves by itself. Next time you come back where you left off.

chapters.title: THE CAMERA AND VIEWS
chapters.what: Look at the world from above, from behind you or through your own eyes.
steps: Press [V] to change the view: ISOMETRIC (from above), BEHIND, FIRST PERSON, and round again.
Turn the view with [Q] and [E]. Tilt it with [Z] and [X] (not in isometric).
In isometric, [R] turns the view a quarter.
Zoom with the mouse wheel.
Drag with the mouse to move the view (isometric) or look around (other views).
Press [0] to put the view back.
tips: More views (MAP VIEW, THIRD PERSON) are in [ESC], SETTINGS, DISPLAY, VIEW.

chapters.title: MENU, PACK AND MAP
chapters.what: Your character page, everything you carry, and the map that takes you places.

sections.head: THE MENU
steps: Press [ESC]. Your CHARACTER page opens: you, your health and stamina, and your gear slots.
Click a gear slot to wear or hold something.
SETTINGS opens the other pages: DISPLAY, ATMOSPHERE, GRAPHICS, SOUND, KEYS, GUIDE and REPORT A BUG.
Press [ESC] again to close it.

sections.head: YOUR PACK
steps: Press [I]. The PACK tab shows your money and what you carry.
Each thing has buttons: EAT, DRINK, HOLD, WEAR, LOOK and more.
SKILLS shows your skills. CRAFT makes things.

sections.head: THE MAP
steps: Press [SHIFT] + [M]. (You need the MAP OF THE SECTION. Everyone starts with one.)
Click a spot on the map to go there. THE STREET or UNDERGROUND changes the level.
MY APARTMENT takes you home.
The CHOOSE A PLACE list at the bottom takes you to any place or room.
The A to H buttons take you to another section.

chapters.title: YOUR CHARACTER
chapters.what: Change your name, body, hair, clothes and shape.
steps: Double-click yourself, or press [ESC] and click EDIT.
The YOU page opens: your name, BUILD, HAIR, BEARD, CLOTHES and SHOES.
For your body's shape click SHAPE, then DESIGN YOUR WALKER. Pick a part and drag the sliders. Click DONE.
Press [M] to take your shoes off or put them on.
Clothes and gear you buy go on through the gear slots on the CHARACTER page.

chapters.title: YOUR APARTMENT
chapters.what: Your own home. Fill it with furniture and make it yours.

sections.head: GETTING IN AND OUT
steps: Double-click the front door of the apartment house (YOUR APARTMENT), or use MY APARTMENT on the map.
To leave, double-click OUT TO THE STREET.
Double-click the FIRE ESCAPE DOOR to open it, then walk out. Double-click a window to open it.

sections.head: DECORATING
steps: At home, press [T]. The DECORATE panel opens: THINGS, WALLS, FLOOR and LIGHTS.
To buy: pick a department or type in FIND, click a thing, then click where it goes.
To move: click a thing and drag it. Green means it fits, red means it doesn't.
Turn it with [Q] [E]. Resize with [SHIFT] + wheel. Lower or raise it with the square-bracket keys.
[DELETE] puts it away. SELL gives you back half. [CTRL] + [Z] undoes.
Press [ESC] when you are done.

sections.head: ORDERING BY DRONE
steps: Double-click THE COMPUTER in your apartment. THE MARKET BBS opens.
Order from the CATALOG. The drone flies it to your fire escape.
Double-click A PARCEL to bring it in.

chapters.title: MONEY AND SHOPS
chapters.what: You start with $1,000,000. Buy from the merchants and sell them what you find.
steps: Double-click a merchant. A talk window opens.
Choose WHAT DO YOU SELL? to open the shop.
Click BUY (or 5 to buy five). Some things are RENT or REFILL.
Merchants who buy things show a BUYS list. Click SELL, or ALL to sell all of one kind.

Who buys what: the Nature Merchant buys butterflies; the Gem Peddler and the golems buy gems; Old Wetwhisker and BAIT & BOATS buy fish; the mushroom seller buys mushrooms, potions, food, butterflies and birds.
To look closely at something, press [5] or LOOK in the pack. Drag to turn it, wheel to zoom.

chapters.title: TALKING TO PEOPLE
chapters.what: The people of THE MARKET talk, remember you, and some have work for you.
steps: Double-click a character. You walk up and they speak.
Choose an answer with [W] [S] or the arrows, then [ENTER]. Or press [1] to [4].
Press [ESC] to walk away. Walking off also ends the talk.

chapters.title: FORAGING AND FOOD
chapters.what: Pick mushrooms and flowers in the park, eat them, sell them or make things.
steps: Go to a park lawn. Press [M] to take your shoes off (shoes squash mushrooms).
Double-click a mushroom or a wildflower to pick it.
Unknown ones are STRANGE MUSHROOM. Press IDENTIFY in your pack.
To eat, press [I] and click EAT. Careful: RED CAP and MOONGLOW poison you. A CURE POTION fixes it.
Mushrooms grow back every day.
Grow your own: buy seeds at the tomato stall, plant them from your pack on bare lawn, and double-click to pick when they bloom.

chapters.title: SKILLS, LESSONS AND CRAFTING
chapters.what: Get better at what you do. Make potions, food and bouquets.

sections.head: SKILLS
steps: Press [I], then SKILLS. A skill grows each time you use it, fastest on hard tasks.
All skills together go up to 600. Set each to ▲ raise, ▼ lower or ■ keep.

sections.head: LESSONS
steps: Merchants teach what they buy: talk to them and choose a LESSON (each +1.0, up to 30).
The arcade games and the holodeck train skills too (see PLACES TO GO).

sections.head: CRAFTING
steps: Press [I], then CRAFT. Pick a recipe and click MAKE.
Potions need a mortar and an empty bottle (you start with both).
Food needs a flame near you: a fire, a candle or a torch.

chapters.title: HEALTH, STAMINA AND HEALING
chapters.what: The red bar is health, the yellow bar is stamina. They show in a fight or in water.
steps: Running, fighting and blocking use stamina. Stop for a moment and it fills again.
Health does not come back by itself.
To heal: double-click a bench, chair or bed and sit (about 2 minutes to full).
Or stand in the bath house steam (under a minute), or eat food and potions.
At zero health you faint for 15 seconds. If you are hit again then, you die (see IF YOU DIE).

chapters.title: FISHING
chapters.what: Fish the Hudson from the pier, THE LAKE in the park, or the pond in each section.

sections.head: GET READY
steps: Go to the Hudson fishing pier. Double-click the BAIT & BOATS stand.
Buy a FISHING ROD ($15) and WORMS or CUT BAIT.
Hold the rod: press [1] until you hold it, or HOLD in your pack.
Face the water. A FISH button shows. Press [F] or click it.

sections.head: CAST AND CATCH
steps: Hold [SPACE]. The bar fills; a ring on the water shows where it will land. Let go to cast.
Wait for a bite. When it says BITE!, press [SPACE] to strike.
Fight: hold [SPACE] to reel. The fish runs left or right. Pull against it: [A] if it runs right, [D] if it runs left. It tires faster.
Watch the LINE bar. Too much strain snaps the line. [W] [S] set the DRAG: low lets the fish take line, high brings it in faster.
When it is out of the water, press [SPACE] to take it off the hook.
[V] changes the view. [ESC] leaves fishing.

sections.head: WHAT BITES
steps: Worms for perch, eels, shad and sturgeon. Cut bait for bass, bluefish, catfish, fluke and crabs.
Deeper water off the pier's end, bigger fish. Bass bite at dusk, eels at night.
Sell your catch at BAIT & BOATS or to Old Wetwhisker.

tips: Better rods cast further on stronger line; better reels reel faster; lures are not used up. All at BAIT & BOATS.

chapters.title: CRAB POTS AND COOLERS
chapters.what: Catch crabs while you are away, and carry more fish.
steps: Buy a CRAB POT ($25) at BAIT & BOATS. You can have three out.
Face the water and press [P] in fishing mode (or DROP IN THE WATER in your pack). If you carry cut bait, the pot is baited and catches twice as fast.
Leave it. Come back later and double-click its orange buoy to haul it up.
You can carry 5 fish in your hands. A cooler (small, medium or big) holds 15, 40 or 100 more. With no room, a new fish goes back in the water.

chapters.title: BUTTERFLIES AND BIRDS
chapters.what: Catch butterflies with a net, tame birds, collect them or sell them.

sections.head: BUTTERFLIES
steps: Buy a BUTTERFLY NET ($8) from the Nature Merchant (the paper fox by the arcade).
Press [1] until you hold the net. Aim with the mouse and click to swing. Swinging fast or jumping helps.
You can carry 5. Jars hold 20, 50 or 100 more.
In your pack: IDENTIFY, MOUNT (needs a frame) or RELEASE.
Butterflies hide at night and in bad weather.

sections.head: BIRDS
steps: Double-click a bird: PICK UP, WATCH, TAME (uses birdseed) or CATCH (needs a bird net and a cage).
A tamed bird follows you. Ask the Nature Merchant HOW DO I CATCH A BIRD? for free seed.

chapters.title: SWIMMING AND DIVING
chapters.what: Swim the Hudson, dive to the bottom and explore the caverns.
steps: Walk into the water to swim.
[SPACE] swims down, [SHIFT] swims up. In first person you swim where you look.
You have 16 seconds of air. It fills again at the surface.
For more air: eat an AIRCAP mushroom (+20 s, from the mushroom seller), or rent a SCUBA SET from THE SHARK ($40, 5 minutes).
A GLOWCAP lets you see in the dark water.
Swim to the bottom in the middle of the Hudson and double-click A CAVE MOUTH. You need 45 seconds of air.

chapters.title: ROWBOAT, KITE AND HOVERBOARD
chapters.what: Get out on the water, fly a kite or ride a board.

sections.head: ROWBOAT
steps: At BAIT & BOATS, choose ROWBOAT · A TRIP ($5).
Row with [W] [A] [S] [D]. You can fish from the boat.
Row to a ladder or the pier and click STEP ASHORE.

sections.head: KITE
steps: Buy a KITE ($10) from the Nature Merchant. Hold it with [1].
Click to launch it. Hold the mouse button to wind it in. On calm days run into the wind.

sections.head: HOVERBOARD
steps: Buy a board from the Boardwright on West St. Hold it with [1].
Click to get on, click to get off. Steer with [W] [A] [S] [D], [SPACE] hops.

chapters.title: FIGHTING
chapters.what: Fists, feet and swords. Fight the dungeon's monsters, or other players.
steps: [J] punches, [K] kicks, [N] slaps. Press again in time to chain a combo (press [?] for them all).
Hold [C] to crouch, then [J] uppercut or [K] sweep. [2] leg sweep, [3] back flip, [4] front flip, [Y] roll, [U] cartwheel.
Hold [P] to block. Block on the beat with a sword to stagger them.
Swords: buy one from the swordsmith. Press [1] to hold it, aim with the mouse, click to swing. Three quick swings make the third a heavy one.
Armour from the knight on Main Street halves the hurt. WEAR it from your pack.
Players: knock one down, then double-click to pick them up and [J] to throw. If you are held, mash any key to break free.

chapters.title: IF YOU DIE
chapters.what: You become a ghost. You can come back.
steps: As a ghost you can walk and go through doors, but not fight or use most things.
Open the map ([SHIFT] + [M]) and choose THE BATHS in CHOOSE A PLACE, or walk there.
Double-click the door of THE BATH HOUSE and walk into the steam.
You come back to life with full health.

chapters.title: THE SUBWAY AND OTHER SECTIONS
chapters.what: Ride the trains, and visit the other sections of the city.
steps: Walk down the green-railed SUBWAY stairs on Market St.
The board on the platform shows each train: NOW, ARRIVING or the minutes until it comes.
A train waits 60 seconds. Walk in through an open door. Double-click a seat to sit.
To get off, walk out through a door while it is open.
To go to another section, open the map ([SHIFT] + [M]) and click a letter, A to H. Each section has its own street, station and park pond.

chapters.title: PLACES TO GO
chapters.what: Double-click a door to go in. Double-click OUT TO THE STREET to leave.

sections.head: THE ARCADE (MAIN ST)
steps: Double-click a cabinet to play ($2). [SPACE] starts, [ESC] leaves.
Each game trains a skill: RAINBOW RUN birding, GALAXY RAID swords, MAZE prospecting, ROAD 85 fishing, TELEMAK entomology, ISTANBUL TAKSI foraging.

sections.head: THE HOLODECK (BACK OF THE ARCADE)
steps: SWORD TRAINING ($8): swing when the knight calls STRIKE!
THE DUEL ($15): hold [P] to block on the beat. Both train swords, and lend you a sword.

sections.head: THE MOVIE THEATRE
steps: Buy a MOVIE TICKET ($5) from the ticket fox, then double-click the door.
Films play on a schedule. Double-click THE SCREEN for sound.

sections.head: THE GOLEMS' CAVE AND THE CASTLE (CENTRAL PARK)
steps: Double-click A GLINT to dig gems; sell them at THE TRADING STONE. A CRACK IN THE FLOOR goes deeper (needs a cutter beam).
The castle's stairs go down to the dungeon: traps, slimes and loot to double-click.

sections.head: MORE
steps: THE BANK on Market St: go in through its big vault door and see the dragon asleep on its gold. It wakes when you come close. Take its gold and it burns you to ashes.
THE BATH HOUSE heals you. The bar has a band. The museum and the playhouse are open to walk around.

chapters.title: OTHER PLAYERS AND CHAT
chapters.what: Everyone in your section is here with you.
steps: Other players walk, fish, fight and wear what they wear, just like you.
Press [ENTER] to chat. Type, then [ENTER] to send ([ESC] closes).
Click ONLINE at the bottom right for the list of players.

chapters.title: SETTINGS, KEYS AND BUGS
chapters.what: Make the game look and play the way you like.
steps: [ESC], SETTINGS. DISPLAY: zoom, view, camera sway, size of the writing.
GRAPHICS: resolution, shadows, outline. ATMOSPHERE: time of day, weather, haze.
KEYS: click a key, then press the one you want. ALL BACK AS THEY WERE resets them.
Found something broken? Press [F8] (or REPORT A BUG), say what happened, and SEND.
Got a Quest 3? Open THE MARKET in its browser and press ENTER VR.
